title: ὥστε and result
subtitle: Identify what follows from the main clause.
overview: ὥστε introduces a result: the following clause tells what came about because of the prior situation.
Read the main clause first, then ask “with what result?” rather than treating ὥστε as a mere vocabulary item.

sections.title: Result patterns
rows: he spoke so that they were amazed
he did so, with the result that they believed
so that there was no longer room

items.grc: συνήχθησαν πολλοὶ ὥστε μηκέτι χωρεῖν μηδὲ τὰ πρὸς τὴν θύραν.
items.en: Many gathered, with the result that there was no longer room, not even near the door.

items.grc: ἐδόξαζον τὸν θεὸν ὥστε πάντας θαυμάζειν.
items.en: They were glorifying God, so that all were amazed.
